Direct mod-2,3,5 chain ranks independently match. Signed fixed-face traces for all 20 dihedral elements give the stated character and representation; graph-edge triangle multiplicities show the natural dihedral group is the full automorphism group.

value.rationale: The pentagonal antiprism is a natural small odd-sided vertex-transitive 4-regular planar graph, and exact perfect-matching extendibility topology is a meaningful comparison to current cubic-ladder and adjacent hexagonal-antiprism results. It has a complete integral homotopy classification, nonshellability, and a full dihedral representation with a nonzero invariant quotient class, contrasting with zero for the hexagonal graph and with mixed-dimensional ordinary matching homology of this same graph. No unsupported infinite-family theorem is inferred.
